body.t: Enter a place query, choose the map display options and copy the generated iframe HTML. The embedded map is provided by Google Maps, not a MapBench-hosted static image. Preview the final embed inside your own website before publishing it. Record the input and mode with any exported or reported result.

Use the query “public library, Pune” and choose an iframe height suitable for your page. Confirm that the preview selected the intended library, then test the copied HTML at both a narrow and wide viewport. A valid iframe can still point to the wrong search result.
